additional_info.subject: 0405667 - ID0405667-DC/Si-D/NL-[Unknown]-ELMS CRM:00440000290
additional_info.body:
Hello Steve,
When I understand that correct, you want to connect your Backendsystem with our Charger via LAN and not via SIM-Card.
We are also not talking about ELMS (External Load Management System) as Mentioned in the Title correct?
If you want to connect your Backend via Lan, you need to attach the LAN Cable to -FA6 in the Bottom of the Charger.
Afterwards you need to Change the Settings in Router configuration via SCB from SIM to wired.
If you need assistance for that you can send me a meeting invitation.
With best regards,
Lukas Berger
